title: Dots and boxes
tagline: Draw lines, close boxes, claim the grid.
teaser: Take turns joining dots. Close a box and it is yours, and you move again. Give away as little as you can.

manPage.synopsis: dab — draw a line; complete a box to score and go again.
manPage.description: Christos Zoulas’s dots and boxes, the youngest game in the directory, with its manual by Thomas Klausner.

howToPlay: Take turns drawing a line between two dots.
Close the fourth side of a box to claim it and go again.
Own the most boxes when the grid is full.
